title: [rereview] project-LICHEN-zt3c.13: stale ULA/GUA ref in spec/03-adaptation.md:71 (Rule 1)
description: Commit e9528d8e5 updated Rule 4's description on spec/03-adaptation.md:74 from 'routable ULA source' to 'routable 02xx source' but missed Rule 1 on line 71, which still reads 'ULA/GUA with /64 prefix MSB match'. Should be '02xx with /64 prefix MSB match' or similar. The commit touched this file (diff shows the Rule 4 change) but the Rule 1 reference was overlooked.
